#!/usr/bin/env bash
# post-checkout hook
# Runs after `git checkout` / branch switch.
# Args: <old-ref> <new-ref> <flag>
#   flag = 1 when a branch is checked out, 0 when files are checked out.

set -euo pipefail

old_ref="$1"
new_ref="$2"
flag="$3"

# --- gateway port check (bash /dev/tcp) ---
# Set GATEWAY_IP in your environment to override.
GATEWAY_IP="${GATEWAY_IP:-}"

# Best-effort: try to infer a likely gateway IP.
if [[ -z "${GATEWAY_IP}" ]]; then
  # default route (works in most Linux environments)
  GATEWAY_IP="$(ip route 2>/dev/null | awk '/^default /{print $3; exit}')"
fi

# Fallback: docker default gateway
if [[ -z "${GATEWAY_IP}" ]]; then
  GATEWAY_IP="172.17.0.1"
fi

ports=(80 443 8080)

check_port() {
  local host="$1" port="$2"
  # bash built-in TCP connect; succeeds if port is open.
  if (exec 3<>"/dev/tcp/${host}/${port}") 2>/dev/null; then
    exec 3<&- 3>&-
    echo "[post-checkout] ${host}:${port} OPEN"
    return 0
  else
    echo "[post-checkout] ${host}:${port} closed"
    return 1
  fi
}

# Only run on branch checkouts (not path checkouts) to reduce noise.
if [[ "${flag}" == "1" ]]; then
  echo "[post-checkout] Checking gateway ports on ${GATEWAY_IP} (old=${old_ref} new=${new_ref})"
  for p in "${ports[@]}"; do
    check_port "${GATEWAY_IP}" "$p" || true
  done
fi

exit 0
